sets.name: Hồng thạch đính đá
sets.brief: Milky blush pink and translucent nude-pink gel. Tiny clear crystal rhinestone arcs near the cuticle, one tasteful marquise crystal accent, micro silver beads, delicate white French edges. Five coordinated but different nail designs, elegant with airy undecorated areas.
sets.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG nail-art asset sheet for a virtual manicure app, photorealistic like high-end glossy press-on nail product cutouts. Exactly FIVE separate upright nails in ONE horizontal row, all FRONT/TOP view, tips pointing UP and rounded cuticle bases DOWN. Use a wide landscape canvas. Divide the canvas into FIVE equal-width columns; center each nail precisely at x=10%,30%,50%,70%,90% of canvas, y=50%. Each nail fits strictly inside its own column with transparent gaps; no nail crosses a column boundary. Thumb,index,middle,ring,pinky order left to right, subtle realistic size differences. No hands, fingers, skin, stands, props, labels, text, watermark, checkerboard pattern, or background. Genuine alpha transparency all around each nail. Decoration and its tiny contact shadows must stay ON the nail, no loose decorations floating outside silhouette. Beautiful restrained luxury salon design, realistic gel translucency, soft curved surface, fine light reflections, individually detailed accents. This is a usable nail texture sheet, not a UI or poster. Milky blush pink and translucent nude-pink gel.
